releaseNotes:
1. Remote Cloud-to-Local Store Reset: Clearing store records from SaaS Hub dispatches an automated administrative directive, securely wiping local SQLite operational data while preserving outlet profile, store license, and admin credentials.
2. Automatic Outbox Purge: Prevents accidental re-synchronization of deleted local records to cloud after a remote reset.
3. Unique Constraint & Prefix Hardening: Database-level unique indexes and prefix enforcement across all terminal and cloud tables.
